connector.name: ZynoHosting
connector.registryDescription: Manage ZynoHosting sites and create, discover, embed, and configure ZynoForms through local stdio.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package zynohosting. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the zyno-io account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ZYNO_HOSTING_MCP_ROOTS
env.description: Optional allowlist of absolute local roots for local-file MCP tools, separated by the platform path delimiter. Omit to allow any local path accessible to the MCP process.

env.name: ZYNO_HOSTING_API_KEY
env.description: Optional tenant API key. Omit it when using credentials saved by zynohosting login.

env.name: ZYNO_SUITE_API_URL
env.description: Optional ZynoSuite API URL override for form tools. Standard production, alpha, and dev environments are inferred automatically.

env.name: ZYNO_AUTH_API_URL
env.description: Optional Zyno Auth API URL override for scoped-token renewal. Standard production, alpha, and dev environments are inferred automatically.
